download_file_from_google_drive: download a file from Google Drive given a file ID and destination path
run_download_from_drive_cli: run the script with a Google Drive file ID and destination file path as arguments
get_confirm_token: extract the confirmation token from a Google Drive response for large file downloads
save_response_content: save the streamed response content from Google Drive to a destination file with progress
review_download_from_drive: review the Google Drive download script to handle file ID and destination path arguments
